name: medium
description: The Medium publication platform logo mark. Three geometric shapes — a circle, a vertical ellipse, and a narrow pill — arranged left to right to form the recognizable 'M' mark.

animation.description: The three shapes draw in sequentially left to right, each tracing itself via stroke before crossfading to a filled state. The stagger (0ms / 150ms / 280ms) follows natural reading direction. Each shape's fill crossfade begins 650ms into its own draw, creating a slight overlap before the stroke completes.

accessibility.notes: When used as a link to a Medium profile or publication, the parent element should provide context (e.g., aria-label='Read on Medium').
